summary_rationale: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd passes the price-blind business-quality screen as an IP-led, engineering-differentiated Tier-1 electronics platform (COMPOUNDER_PASS) with PASS_WITH_WATCH operational KPIs. Founded out of IIT Bombay in 2007, SEDEMAC has built genuine technological moats in patented sensorless Integrated Starter Generator (ISG) and Electronic Fuel Injection (EFI) ECUs (86.2% Mobility mix in FY26) alongside a ~75% domestic market share in Indian genset AMF controllers (13.8% Industrial mix). Revenue compounded at 34.5% over five years to ₹1,058 Cr in FY26 (₹1,265 Cr TTM) with ROCE reaching 35.3% and ROE 26.9%. However, three structural risks require active monitoring: (1) extreme customer concentration with TVS Motor (~75–81% of revenue) and top-3 OEMs (>90%); (2) H1 FY27 working-capital and capex intensity that pushed Debtor Days to 46.1, FY26 Free Cash Flow to -₹47 Cr, and Sep 2026 borrowings from ₹72 Cr to ₹352 Cr to fund MF3/MF5 and semiconductor inventory; and (3) gross-margin sensitivity to global PCB and semiconductor inflation (H1 FY27 OPM at 19.2% vs 21.4% YoY).
